module: Auxiliary controlled center differential controller. Every physics step, it combines several jbeam maps (throttle, slip between axles, brake, left-foot brake, steering, handbrake) to compute a desired locking rate 0..1 and writes it into centerDiff.activeLockCoef. Under acceleration the target mixes understeer/oversteer (biasOversteerVsTraction) and traction; under deceleration it depends on the brake and steering.
notes: jbeam keys read in init: biasOversteerVsTraction (0.5), throttleLockMap, allowedSlipMap, slipLockMap, brakeLockMap, leftFootBrakeLockMap, steeringLockMap, handbrakeLockMap (maps for interpolatedMap: input x = pedal/steering/slip, y = speed in m/s), centerDiffName, axleDiff1Name, axleDiff2Name (powertrain device names).
Reads electrics.values: wheelspeed, throttle_input, brake_input, parkingbrake, steering_input, absActive. Slip = |AV_front - AV_rear| / max(|AV|, 0.1) with the inputAV of the two axle differentials.
The locking is set to 0 when the ABS is active (factor 1 - absActive) and multiplied by the handbrake map.
Deceleration mode if throttle_input - brake_input < -0.01, otherwise acceleration.
If one of the three differentials is not found: print "Diff(s) not found" and updateFixedStep/updateGFX are set to nil.
The source comments mention initLastStage/resetLastStage functions not exported in M.

init.desc: Loads the seven jbeam maps and gets the center differential and the two axle differentials.

updateFixedStep.desc: Physics step: computes the desired locking and sets it on centerDiff.activeLockCoef.
